messages:
Add cancel to the rental service

cancel(bookingId, at) frees the booking's equipment and returns
{ bookingId, refund }. A booking cancelled before its period starts is
refunded in full; one cancelled at or after the start is not refunded.
A booking can be cancelled only once.
